findings.problem: The eight-path sensor only reads .semgrepignore lines that start with the pki fixture prefix, so a broad entry such as '**/*.pem' or 'packages/signature/' would still pass, although ADR decision 2 claims the test rejects broad globs and non-fixture paths.
findings.required_fix: Have an Inspector bind the whole .semgrepignore entry list, or reject any glob or pem/key entry outside the eight exact paths, then have an Architect rebind trace.
